text: {"lessons":["My account fell about 20% from Period 1 to Period 10, so I should take sustained losses seriously and review whether my holdings still fit my goals—not just assume they will recover.","Selling some B and D at losses while adding E after it had risen did not prevent the portfolio from declining; I should base trades on a clear plan, not recent price moves or the urge to make a change.","I should check how much risk comes from holding similar-sized positions in five stocks, and keep enough cash and regular savings to support my apartment goal without relying on quick gains."]}
